title: Color not true to photos
text: Color not true to photos. I picked this because it looked like a good beige rig that world compliment my carpet and other furnishings. The photos like beige, but when the rug arrived, is very very white. So white I have to send it back (not only does it not match anything, I have a black cat so it will turn grey quickly, and also because I'm a tall human not a robot, so white flooring is just not practical). It seems like a decent rug, so I'm sad the color is so un-functional.

description: Inspired by Moroccan tribal patterns, these neutral rugs from Safavieh’s Arizona Shag Collection offer a relaxing and stylish retreat. Artfully crafted with a woven backing, this Collection has substantial body and durability.
